title: HOS EXPLOITATION
description: Technical analysis of HOS violations and ELD tampering. We use digital forensics to prove truck driver fatigue and carrier coercion.
heading: HOS
intro: Driver fatigue is a systemic failure, not an individual choice. We expose the digital paper trails that prove carriers prioritize delivery speed over human life.

analysisPoints.title: ELD Data Forensics
analysisPoints.detail: We scrub raw Electronic Logging Device (ELD) data for "ghost miles" and manual edits that hide overtime driving. We correlate GPS pings with fuel receipts.

analysisPoints.title: The 14-Hour Rule
analysisPoints.detail: Commercial drivers have a strict 14-hour duty window. We prove violations when carriers pressure drivers to "off-duty" while still operating the vehicle.

analysisPoints.title: Fatigue Microsleep Analysis
analysisPoints.detail: Using dashcam footage and steering input data, we identify the signature patterns of "microsleep" caused by chronic HOS non-compliance.

analysisPoints.title: Carrier Pressure Audit
analysisPoints.detail: We subpoena dispatch logs and internal messaging apps to find direct evidence of dispatchers coercing drivers to bypass mandatory rest breaks.

detail: "Paper logs" are a relic of the past, but digital tampering is the new frontier. We work with IT forensic specialists to recover deleted duty status records and verify ELD sensor integrity.
